headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an effect size of 1.15 (95% CI: 0.87–1.5), indicating no statistically significant association between antioxidants and prostate cancer\aggressive. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 90.34%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
